items.label: Material & Size
items.value: Lightweight & water-resistant soft puffy cross body purse (just 0.44lbs) Compact size 10.2''x 4.5''x 8.3'' with 4.6L capacity - perfect daily essentials

items.label: Multi-Pocket Design
items.value: Crossbody bag features Front zip, main pocket, interior zip, and back zip—styled with different props to show you just how much it holds

items.label: Thoughtful Features
items.value: Travel purse comes with pinterior key clip, adjustable strap for all body types, and smooth-zip durability

items.label: Rigid Bum Bag
items.value: This fanny pack's adorable dumpling shape stays chic, not bulky—a versatile must-have for any outfit

items.label: Any Occasion, Any Style
items.value: Wear it 4 ways—travel purse, shoulder bag, handbag, or mini tote. Ideal for travel, workouts, hiking, and daily use

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine washable, tumble dry low, do not iron, store in a cool dry place.
